title: Open datasets and machine learning for two-phase heat transfer: a review following a spatial-temporal taxonomy
abstract: arXiv:2605.23037v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Two-phase heat transfer underpins boiling, condensation, immersion cooling, flow boiling, energy conversion, and electronics thermal management, but its coupled interfacial physics make data reuse and model comparison difficult. This narrative review synthesizes open datasets, machine-learning methods, and reusable software for two-phase heat-transfer research, with emphasis on boiling, multimodal sensing, and thermal-management datasets. We organize the review around a spatial-plus-temporal dimensionality taxonomy, denoted S+TD, that classifies data objects by the dimensionality of the measured, simulated, or derived fields, including 0+0D point values, 0+1D time series, 1+1D profiles, 2+0D images, 2+1D videos, 3+0D/3+1D fields, and mixed multimodal records. translated_title: 开放数据集与机器学习在两相换热中的应用：基于时空分类法的综述
translated_abstract: 两相换热是沸腾、冷凝、浸没冷却、流动沸腾、能量转换和电子热管理的基础，但其耦合的界面物理特性使得数据复用和模型比较变得困难。本叙述性综述综合了用于两相换热研究的开放数据集、机器学习方法和可复用软件，重点涵盖沸腾、多模态传感和热管理数据集。我们围绕一种空间加时间维度分类法（记为S+TD）组织综述，该分类法根据测量、模拟或派生场的维度对数据对象进行分类，包括0+0D点值、0+1D时间序列、1+1D剖面、2+0D图像、2+1D视频、3+0D/3+1D场以及混合多模态记录。该分类法用于将数据集类型与AI任务关联，如表格回归、声学序列学习、图像分割、视频分析和逆热通量重建。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于空间和时间维度的S+TD分类法，系统梳理了两相换热领域中的开放数据集、机器学习方法和软件工具，以促进数据复用和模型比较。
en_tdlr: This review introduces a spatial-temporal dimensionality (S+TD) taxonomy to systematically organize open datasets, machine-learning methods, and software for two-phase heat transfer, aiming to enhance data reuse and model comparison.
